t: Johnstones Trade Covaplus Brilliant White Matt Emulsion Paint is a premium water-based vinyl matt paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. The high-quality emulsion is ideal for professional decorators and busy trade environments requiring a durable, wipeable finish. The improved formulation delivers superior opacity and an impressive coverage of 17m²/Ltr, meaning fewer coats are needed on large-scale projects. It is touch-dry in 1 to 2 hours and recoatable in 2 to 4 hours, allowing tradespeople to complete jobs quickly and efficiently using a brush, roller, or spray.
b: Brilliant White Matt Finish with Excellent Opacity
Provides Wipeable Surface for Easy Maintenance
